back.en: The study of living things and their life processes
back.bm: Kajian tentang benda hidup dan proses hidupnya

back.en: Zoology, botany, microbiology, genetics, ecology, physiology, anatomy, biotechnology
back.bm: Zoologi, botani, mikrobiologi, genetik, ekologi, fisiologi, anatomi, bioteknologi

back.en: Doctor, nurse, pharmacist, veterinarian, forensic scientist, biotechnologist, agricultural officer, marine biologist
back.bm: Doktor, jururawat, ahli farmasi, doktor haiwan, saintis forensik, ahli bioteknologi, pegawai pertanian, ahli biologi marin

back.en: Lab coat, gloves, goggles, face mask, closed shoes
back.bm: Kot makmal, sarung tangan, gogal, topeng muka, kasut tertutup

back.en: Sterilises equipment and biological waste with high-pressure steam (~121 °C)
back.bm: Mensterilkan peralatan dan sisa biologi dengan stim bertekanan tinggi (~121 °C)

back.en: Enclosed, filtered workspace for handling microorganisms
back.bm: Ruang kerja tertutup dan bertapis untuk mengendalikan mikroorganisma

back.en: Use a special sharps container — never the normal bin
back.bm: Guna bekas objek tajam khas — bukan tong sampah biasa

back.en: Microorganism cultures, animal tissues, blood, sharps — each disposed of separately after sterilising
back.bm: Kultur mikroorganisma, tisu haiwan, darah, objek tajam — setiap satu dilupuskan berasingan selepas disterilkan

back.en: Problem → hypothesis → plan → experiment → data → analyse → conclude → report
back.bm: Masalah → hipotesis → rancang → eksperimen → data → analisis → simpul → lapor

back.en: To get reliable results and reduce random errors
back.bm: Untuk mendapat keputusan yang boleh dipercayai dan mengurangkan ralat rawak

back.en: Same set-up without the factor being tested, for comparison
back.bm: Susunan sama tanpa faktor yang diuji, untuk perbandingan
